summary: This is an 8-K filed by Rackspace Technology, Inc. disclosing a GPU-as-a-Service Agreement with Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) for the phased deployment of AMD AI compute products (including MI355X, MI350P GPUs and EPYC CPUs) across its global data centers. The initial launch footprint is 30 MW of capacity exclusively for AMD Products, with deployment starting late 2026 through 2028, subject to financing, operational and legal conditions. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction or forced management change is described; it is a routine commercial contract.
